name: Lack Of Colors
source:
Ai Tanaka is a 21-year-old girl who wakes up out of nowhere without the ability to see colors.

Without being able to think of a reason that would convince her at first.

Before the lights-on event in her city square she will try to find a reason to her loss of colors, as long as she does not immerse herself in the despair of not being able to find it she will be fine.

[From [url=https://quetzalcoutl.itch.io/lack-of-colors]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
田中爱是一名21岁的女孩，她突然醒来，失去了看到颜色的能力。

一开始想不出一个能让她信服的理由。

在城市广场亮灯之前，她会尝试寻找失去颜色的原因，只要她不沉浸在找不到颜色的绝望中就可以了。

[来自[url=https://quetzalcoutl.itch.io/lack-of-colors]itch.io[/url]]
